shop_info.name: FreshMeat
shop_info.location: Downtown area, next to the central plaza
shop_info.opening_hours: Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM

fish_products.description: Freshly caught river and sea fish.
fish_products.availability: Varies by season and daily catch

delivery_information.details: Free home delivery within 5 miles for orders over $20. Delivery takes 30-45 minutes.

ordering_information.details: Customers can order via the website, our mobile app, or by calling 555-0198.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Are your meats Halal?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes, all our chicken and mutton products are 100% Halal certified.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Do you sell marinated meats?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes, we offer a variety of pre-marinated chicken and fish ready to cook.

frequently_asked_questions.question: Do you accept credit cards?
frequently_asked_questions.answer: Yes, we accept all major credit cards and digital wallets.
